title: fix(providers): Groq Qwen 3.6 fails every turn and two models wrongly accept images
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: every turn with Groq `qwen/qwen3.6-27b` fails with `400 reasoning_effort must be one of none or default` at the default thinking level, and the catalog advertises image input for it and for Cohere `north-mini-code-1-0`, which both reject images.

## User Impact

User impact: Groq Qwen 3.6 27B works at any thinking level (Off sends `none`; every other level sends `default`), its reasoning is returned as a separate thinking block instead of `<think>` text in the reply, and neither model is offered for image attachments it cannot accept.

## Why This Change Was Made

Both rows came from bulk catalog refreshes (#113681, #102489) without live capability checks. Groq's Qwen endpoint accepts only `none|default` for `reasoning_effort`, so the row now uses the same catalog-only effort map shape as the Cohere reasoning rows. With reasoning on, Groq inlines `<think>` text into `content` unless `reasoning_format` is set, so the Groq plugin's provider-owned payload hook requests `reasoning_format: "parsed"` for Qwen-family reasoning requests (not for effort `none`, not for GPT-OSS, which uses a different Groq contract); the existing completions stream already maps the separate reasoning field into a thinking block. Picker behavior is unchanged (Cohere-style aliased levels), so no shared picker code changes.

## Evidence

- Live Groq `qwen/qwen3.6-27b` (2026-10-13): effort `none` → 200; `default` / omitted → 200 with `<think>` inlined in content; `low|medium|high` → 400; `reasoning_format: "hidden"` → 200 with clean content and separate reasoning tokens; image part → 400.
- Live gateway agent smoke before the fix: `groq/qwen/qwen3.6-27b` failed every turn with `LLM request rejected: reasoning_effort must be one of none or default | 400`.
- Live gateway agent smoke **on this branch** (thinking=high): `groq/qwen/qwen3.6-27b` prompt, read-tool, and exec-tool probes all pass; `cohere/north-mini-code-1-0` prompt/read/exec pass and the image probe is no longer attempted (183/183 tests).
- Live Cohere `north-mini-code-1-0` image request → 400 `image content is not supported for this model`.
- `pnpm test extensions/groq extensions/cohere` (15 tests), `openai-completions-stream.test.ts` (46), targeted tsgo typecheck, `git diff --check`.
- Independent Codex review: scoped-clean.
- Exact-head CI [run 38528286044](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38528286044), attempt 1, completed with one inherited failure: `checks-fast-baseline-ratchets` reports `src/process/terminal-pty.test.ts:40: ./terminal-pty-node.js` in the mock-export check. The failed file and `scripts/check-test-mock-exports.mts` are byte-identical between CI baseline `5e9b5749d7104ab17302543a74576be9641e5841` and tested merge `839087d1e0589084452e34a8d5f1933dec3da85e` (ordered parents: baseline, PR head `c656fcfc111dc4a8eae402200560a2cc8ac2d093`). Automated classification was `unknown` because scheduled main had no comparable result; this attribution comes from the exact failing log and unchanged source objects. The aggregate CI gate fails only because of this inherited ratchet failure. All other selected jobs passed, including `security-fast`, extension lint, and typechecks. Native inherited-failure admission is required; CI is not being represented as green.
- Local-only lint gap: SDK declaration preparation timed out on the overloaded host, causing unresolved `StreamFn` types in extension oxlint. Exact-head hosted extension lint passed, resolving that gap without repeating the completed local proof.
